mostWorthwhile.text: Making water-altered rock was most worthwhile: it explained how water can become incorporated into minerals rather than remain visible as ice.

leastWorthwhile.text: Cooling the altered rock felt less clear as a separate step; I was unsure what open space would do until the result explained it.

surprise.text: A frozen-looking body can contain liquid water that reacts with rock, leaving hydrogen in hydrated minerals.

arbitrary.text: Using open space to cool the altered rock was not obvious from the option alone, although the result explained the cooling.

continue.text: Yes. The contrast between differentiated rocky bodies and water-altered icy bodies made me curious how their material contributes to a growing world, though the forced sequences left few meaningful choices.
